title: Sound Logos
description: Commericals, YouTube intros, application loading screens. Everything we use or consume nowadays has a sound logo to associate with a brand. This exercise was to understand how to cater towards a particular audience within a composition and what helps promote certain emotions or interest. Three different applications were composed for using differing scales, instrumentation, and sample manipulation.

audio.label: Fantasy/Children
audio.desc: Whimsical and jovial. This logo could be applied to something such as a kid's toy brand as an example. The mallet instrumenation, swung rhythms, and a major key all combine for this application.

audio.label: Lifestyle
audio.desc: Calm, soothing, a long exhale. This logo could be applied to a spa or health product as an example. Warm strings and extended chords give the meditative feel without overwhelming the listener.

audio.label: Horror
audio.desc: Footsteps, screams, and a chainsaw. This logo could be applied to a horror film studio as an example. This logo was sample heavy to help convey a quick story to the listener. Sample manipulation was used, as the 'chainsaw' was originally a sheep's bah and the scream at the end was a hawk's cry.
